source_title: Chemicals in Q3 2026: Where the industry stands
business_context: As a part of an October 2026 Chemicals quarterly industry review, McKinsey described chemical equity performance with S&P Global/Capital IQ and McKinsey Value Intelligence sources. Public text gives base chemicals market-cap changes since the start of 2023.
key_message: 2023년 초 이후 기초화학업체의 시가총액 변화가 중화권 이외 지역 약 −1,100억 달러와 중화권 약 +250억 달러로 갈리므로, 화학업 포트폴리오 판단에는 업종 평균보다 지역별 수익·밸류에이션의 분화를 먼저 살펴야 한다.

data_spec.uncertainty_notes: Original labelled values are approximations when stated as about/approximately; no pixel digitization or invented precision.

data_recipe: company_id; company_name; geography; business_segment; as_of_date; equity_market_cap_usd; listing_currency; fx_to_usd; inclusion_flag. Choose a consistently defined base-chemicals universe, verify corporate actions/new listings and currency conversions, aggregate market cap by regional group at base date and end date, and calculate Δcap($bn)=(sum_end−sum_base)/1e9. Separate population/FX changes from underlying performance.
message_conditions: The regional divergence shown by the two reported approximate values supports only an aggregate capitalisation contrast. Changes in the company universe, FX, and M&A can affect comparability. The article figure has more breakdowns than these two reported numbers, so a full replica is not supported.
